pages.title: Start With Coffee
pages.text: Search open plains or forest edges for $(l:psychedelicraft:growing/coffea)coffea$(/l), a stalk with bright cherries. Check plains village greenhouses too. Plant a few cherries and smelt two for your first cup.

pages.title: Set Up at Home
pages.text: Till soil beside water and leave room above tall crops. Put a furnace and a $(l:psychedelicraft:processing/drying)drying table$(/l) in a bright shelter. Nine identical ingredients make one drying batch.

pages.title: A Second Project
pages.text: Bring home ordinary mushrooms to learn drying, or find hops and use wheat to make $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/brewing_examples)your first beer$(/l). The production chapters show how to fill a cup, store a batch, and automate transfers.
